claimed_coverage: Tests that Pillow version matches the version specified in the repository's Dockerfile, verifying the security fix GHSA-44wm-f244-xhp3 is applied.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch changes pillow==10.2.0 to pillow==10.3.0 in src/anaconda/.devcontainer/Dockerfile and src/anaconda/test-project/test.sh to address security vulnerability GHSA-44wm-f244-xhp3.
issue_context_used: The issue.md describes the need for the container to be built with Pillow >= 10.3.0 and for the validation script to verify this version requirement.
notes: Updated eval.sh to sync Pillow version with repository state. The script now parses src/anaconda/.devcontainer/Dockerfile to extract the required Pillow version and installs it before running tests. This ensures testWithFix scenario passes (Dockerfile specifies 10.3.0 after fix.patch is applied) and testOnly scenario fails (Dockerfile specifies 10.2.0 in buggy state).
